reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats. It was signed 2025-08-19 and took effect 2025-09-01.

I also told her that 185 is still the active count today. Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises it to 230 seats from 2027-01-01, which she may want in the QBR deck.

The figures come from the amendment documents and the account page in the knowledge brain. Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed. Dana also owns the account.
